pages.title: VB-G RAM G replacing MGNREGA — draft rules

facts.text: Viksit Bharat–Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025 (VB-G RAM G) replaces MGNREGA (2005)
facts.head: Scheme

facts.text: Ministry of Rural Development released draft rules (wages, unemployment allowance, allocation, Central Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Council)
facts.head: Scheme

facts.text: Feature: Workdays; MGNREGA: 100; VB-G RAM G: 125
facts.head: Scheme

facts.text: Feature: Wage funding; MGNREGA: Centre 100%; VB-G RAM G: States bear 40% (NE/Himalayan & UTs with legislature 90:10; UTs without legislature 100% Centre)
facts.head: Scheme

facts.text: Feature: Allocation; MGNREGA: State labour budgets; VB-G RAM G: Centre's normative allocation (16th FC horizontal devolution formula)
facts.head: Scheme

facts.text: Feature: Farm season; VB-G RAM G: 60-day pause in peak sowing/harvest
facts.head: Scheme

facts.text: Feature: Payment; MGNREGA: Bank/post office; VB-G RAM G: DBT
facts.head: Scheme

facts.text: Old job cards valid after renewal + e-KYC until Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards issued
facts.head: Scheme

facts.text: Part of allocation performance-linked (timely wages, social audit)
facts.head: Scheme

facts.text: ⚠ MGNREGA: unskilled manual work; at least one-third women
facts.head: Scheme

facts.text: Govt notified implementation — Act to come into force from 1 July 2026; allocation ₹95,692 crore
facts.head: Notification

facts.text: Childcare facilities at worksites made mandatory
facts.head: Notification
